task_d_confidence_analysis.relevance_definition: Canonical is_relevant() (token containment >= 0.60 AND 8-gram verbatim match)
task_d_confidence_analysis.formula_history_note: Formula modified from s1*(0.5 + max(0, s1-s2)) on RRF scores to s1*(0.5 + 0.5*(s1-s2)/s1) on Qdrant dense vector cosine similarity scores.

roc_auc_analysis.informativeness_eval: ROC AUC ~ 0.52 indicates confidence is weakly/non-informative as a predictor of relevance.
roc_auc_analysis.policy_decision: ROC AUC 0.6640 (95% CI [0.5763, 0.7517]) confirms confidence is uninformative for gating; gating on unvalidated confidence is disallowed.

refusal_correctness_and_tradeoff.refusal_tradeoff_statement: Refusing at this threshold suppresses 111 unsupported answers at the cost of 13 supported ones.

reconciliation_notes.101_origin_explanation: 101 came from checking document ID match across all Qdrant chunks from the same doc_id. Using the canonical is_relevant() span check yields exactly 85 queries with gold passage present.
reconciliation_notes.refusal_accuracy_change_explanation: Refusal accuracy moved 60.71% -> 85.71% when evaluated against canonical is_relevant() (84 gold-absent queries out of 98 total refusals).
